name: Joffre Lakes
region: Pipi7íyekw / Joffre Lakes Park, British Columbia
why: Three turquoise lakes one above the other, the last at the foot of the Matier Glacier, in a park co-managed with the Lil'wat and N'Quatqua Nations.
book: Free trail pass for each person from mid-May to late October (BC Parks, from 7:00 two days before). The park closes some weeks for Lil'wat and N'Quatqua cultural use (in 2026: 20-27 June and 8-30 September): check before you go.
water: Creeks between the lakes; treat it.
dangers: Do not walk on the fallen log over the lake or swim under the glacier.
Icy trail in spring and late autumn.
Busy trail: the parking lot fills early.
